options.name: tls_accept
options.description: Type of allowed incoming connections for autoregistration. Choose from C(unsecure), C(tls_with_psk) or both.

options.name: tls_psk
options.description: TLS connection uses this PSK value. This setting requires I(tls_accept=tls_with_psk) if current value of I(tls_accept) is C(unsecure).

options.name: tls_psk_identity
options.description: TLS connection uses this PSK identity string. The PSK identity string will be transmitted unencrypted over the network. Therefore, you should not put any sensitive information here. This setting requires I(tls_accept=tls_with_psk) if current value of I(tls_accept) is C(unsecure).
